images.filename: View looking east-northeast down Wentworth Street - geograph.org.uk - 1703445.jpg
images.caption: View looking east-northeast down Wentworth Street This is a view of Petticoat Lane Market, although strangely and rather misleadingly the street it is situated on is actually called Wentworth Street. I'm pretty sure Wentworth Street is photographed on the very first still image of the opening sequence of the sitcom Only Fools and Horses. It does look very similar and Petticoat Lane would certainly be Del Boy's territory! In fact, Uncle Albert does mention it in one episode! Anyway, back to Geograph talk, this view was taken looking east-northeast from the junction with Cobb Street.
images.alt: View looking east-northeast down Wentworth Street This is a view of Petticoat Lane Market, although strangely and rather misleadingly the street it is situated on is actually called Wentworth Street. I'm pretty sure Wentworth Street is photographed on the very first still image of the opening sequence of the sitcom Only Fools and Horses. It does look very similar and Petticoat Lane would certainly be Del Boy's territory! In fact, Uncle Albert does mention it in one episode! Anyway, back to Geograph talk, this view was taken looking east-northeast from the junction with Cobb Street.
